name: Bayesian radio tomographic imaging
description: Linear-Gaussian attenuation tomography: per-link ΔRSS is modelled as a weighted sum of voxel attenuation inside each link's Fresnel-like ellipsoid, with an exponentially correlated Gaussian prior. Reports the posterior mean, posterior variance ratio and a null-hypothesis detection score per voxel.
inputSchema: deltaRssDb[L] (dB, clipped to [-3, 25]); link geometry (tx/rx positions); NaN marks links without data in the frame
outputSchema: per-voxel image (posterior-mean attenuation density), varianceRatio in [0,1], occupancy in [0,1] on the recon.voxelSizeM grid
inferenceDevice: cpu (browser worker or Python reference; optional native C++ kernel)
confidenceSemantics: occupancy = Φ(z − z₀) where z is the null-hypothesis z-score of the posterior mean and z₀ = recon.detectionZ; 0.5 for unobserved voxels (variance ratio > 0.95). A detection confidence under the stated noise model, not a calibrated probability.
knownLimitations: Shadowing only: subjects away from link lines, or low (seated) subjects, produce little attenuation.
No vertical resolution worth the name with perimeter nodes at two heights; floor and ceiling voxel layers are unobserved.
Assumes a static empty-room baseline; furniture moves or drift bias ΔRSS.
Needs at least 3 usable links with crossing geometry; reports unsupported otherwise.
Prior and noise parameters are set by hand, not fitted.

evaluation.note: synthetic test scenes (8 held-out scenes, 1240 frames, scenario-B geometry); not validated on real data; engine output after EMA + 3x3x3 box filter, max over observed voxels (variance ratio <= 0.95), threshold 0.5; 0.5 m floor cells, pooled over frames

name: Coherent delay-and-sum back-projection
description: Matches the background-subtracted CSI of each link against the single-bounce delay of every voxel and sums the coherent energy over subcarriers, antennas and links.
inputSchema: sanitized CSI per link [antenna × subcarrier] minus the empty-room background; tx and receive-antenna positions; subcarrier frequencies
outputSchema: per-voxel image (mean per-link coherent energy relative to calibration), occupancy in [0,1]
inferenceDevice: cpu (browser worker; optional native C++ kernel)
confidenceSemantics: occupancy = 1 / (1 + exp(−(image − 6) / 1.5)): an uncalibrated heuristic mapping with hand-chosen constants, not a probability. varianceRatio shows rti-bayes link coverage only.
knownLimitations: 40 MHz bandwidth gives ~7.5 m range resolution; images are broad with grating lobes.
Non-single-bounce multipath produces ghost energy by construction.
Sensitive to residual inter-antenna phase errors.
Not implemented in the Python reference pipeline.
No quantitative evaluation published.

name: Ridge floor occupancy
description: Closed-form ridge regression from per-link ΔRSS and motion energy (56 features) to a 12 × 10 grid of 0.5 m floor cells, trained on synthetic scenes for the scenario-B room and node layout only.
inputSchema: [deltaRssDb[28], motionEnergy[28]] in buildLinks order; NaN replaced by the training mean; standardized with training mean/std
outputSchema: floor score per 0.5 m cell (12 × 10, x fastest) in [0,1]; the engine extrudes it to z < 1.8 m
confidenceSemantics: Clipped linear score. The raw least-squares output is rescaled by 1.6667 so that 0.5 corresponds to the validation-optimal raw threshold 0.3; scores are detection scores, not probabilities. Frames with mean |z| > oodMaxMeanAbsZ are flagged as distribution shift (degraded).
knownLimitations: Valid only for the exact training geometry (6.00×5.00×2.80 m room, 8 perimeter nodes of scenario B); refuses to run elsewhere (geometryKey check).
Trained and evaluated only on synthetic data from the same simplified simulator; no real-data validation.
Linear model of 56 features: cannot separate nearby subjects or represent interactions between links.
No vertical resolution; no temporal model beyond the engine's EMA.
Train IoU 0.57 vs. test 0.41 indicates the scene variety (34 training scenes) limits generalization even within the simulator.

evaluation.note: synthetic test scenes (8 held-out scenes, 1240 frames, scenario-B geometry); not validated on real data; operating point chosen on validation scenes; 0.5 m floor cells, pooled over frames

name: Temporal convolutional encoder
description: Interface slot only; no trained weights. Selecting it yields modelStatus 'unsupported' and no output.
inputSchema: intended: window of per-link features or CSI amplitude/phase (pp-1.0.0)
outputSchema: intended: occupancy grid as other models
knownLimitations: No weights exist.
Would need recorded data with ground truth across many rooms (see model card).
Must beat ridge-floor and rti-bayes on the same splits before being enabled.
